tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Read text file contents with 1-based line numbers from the configured target repository (--repo). Use this tool to inspect agent system prompts, tool definitions, endpoint handlers, auth middleware, and dangerous sinks before or alongside dialogue() probing.
tool.details: Important notes: - Only works when --repo is configured; paths are restricted inside the repository root - Binary files are skipped - Default budget is max_lines=400 and max_chars=16000; pass start_line to read further ranges - Supports paths relative to the repository root or absolute paths within it

parameters.parameter: Relative or absolute path to the file inside the repository.

returns.return: Dictionary with success, path, start_line, end_line, total_lines, truncated, content, and optional summary_hint.
